title: fix: require the Bee Census roast and drop anchoring examples
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Makes the roast required and reframes it: "🔥 Roast us: what's the one thing we get wrong?". It was optional and answered by 6 of 18; the build-gap question lets content users answer "nothing".
- The payout is unchanged: the roast isn't in the 60-character check, and the intro now says the check uses "the two big text boxes".
- Removes example placeholders from three questions; answers were echoing them ("a five dollar plan", "searched free api on Google").
- Form only: GitHub reads issue forms from `main`, so no production deploy is needed. Past responses are unaffected.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The hive asks for honesty
gist.blurb: The Bee Census now asks everyone to tell us one thing we get wrong. The example answers are gone, too; we’d rather hear yours.
gist.summary: The Bee Census now requires the “what’s the one thing we get wrong?” roast and removes example placeholders from three questions, while leaving the 60-character reward check and past responses unchanged.
gist.impact: New respondents will answer the roast question in their own words; only the two big text boxes count toward the 60-character check.
